chunks: And among them is Abu Tahir Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal

His story is well-known regarding what occurred between him and Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amari, may Allah lighten his visage. He held onto the wealth that was with him for the Imam, refused to deliver it, and claimed that he was the representative, until the community turned away from him and cursed him. And there came out from the Master of the Age (peace be upon him) regarding him what is well-known.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَانَ ال: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amari
key_terms.أَبُو طَاهِرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْن: Abu Tahir Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal

ai.seo_question: Who was Abu Tahir Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal and why was he cursed by the community?
ai.summary: Abu Tahir Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Bilal exemplifies the phenomenon of *al-wakil al-kadhib* (the false agent) during the Minor and Major Ghaiba, where individuals seized control of the Imam's funds (*khums* and donations) to fabricate authority. His story is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for establishing the criteria of authentic deputyship, as his self-aggrandizement and retention of wealth led the community to disown him and curse him, with a specific decree from the Imam confirming this rejection.
